findings: DataTable pagination button sizing — Pagination buttons use min-h-[44px] sm:min-h-auto but may be too small on intermediate viewport sizes between mobile and sm breakpoint. Test at 400-500px widths.
Mobile sidebar backdrop z-index — backdrop uses z-40 while sidebar uses z-50, but no explicit z-index context management. Could conflict with other overlays.
Grid column duplication in Form.tsx — FieldRow component has duplicate object key definitions for columns 2, 3, and 4 (lines 264-266) which will cause only the last values to be used.
